sources.title: Time Series Momentum
sources.claim_summary: Past excess returns can predict the direction of a diversified futures position.

hypothesis: An instrument with positive trailing return may continue trending over the next holding period.
entry_rule: At the close, enter long when trailing return is positive and short when it is negative.
exit_rule: Rebalance at the next scheduled daily close or when the signal changes sign.
sizing_rule: Equal risk contribution across instruments, capped at one unit of exposure.
execution_assumptions: signal executes on the next bar

variants.description: Use a three-month trailing return instead of twelve months.

ambiguities: The original study uses multiple futures markets and portfolio normalization details must be selected.
